description: This Java class 'UtilHtml' provides utility methods for HTML validation, parsing, and theme folder management within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for HTML validation with Jsoup, checking unclosed tags with XMLStream, and retrieving theme folder names to exempt.

classes.name: UtilHtml
classes.description: Final utility class providing HTML validation, unclosed tag detection, theme folder retrieval, and logging functionalities.

methods.name: createJSoupHtmlParser
methods.description: Creates and configures a Jsoup HTML parser with error tracking enabled.

methods.name: validateHtmlFragmentWithJSoup
methods.description: Validates an HTML fragment for errors using Jsoup parser.

methods.name: hasUnclosedTag
methods.description: Checks for unclosed tags in HTML content using XMLStream and returns a list of errors.

methods.name: getVisualThemeFolderNamesToExempt
methods.description: Retrieves theme folder names to be exempted based on theme XML files, filtering out common themes and e-commerce themes.

methods.name: logHtmlWarning
methods.description: Logs a warning message related to HTML parsing issues.
